_doc: Remote real-NVMe validation of the cardinality-cliff work on c4d-standard-16-lssd (physically-attached Titanium NVMe local SSD), server pinned to 4 vCPU / 4 shards (production write shape, AGENTS.md §3). Four configs, same image, same-binary A/Bs: (1) memory-gated vs memory-nogate validates the #1 memory sidecar fix on real NVMe; (2) wal-fsync1 vs wal-fsync16 tests whether parallelizing the checkpoint fdatasync scales on real NVMe (it regressed on 2-vCPU/virtiofs locally). Pool client: disjoint per-pod slices, plain appends, pre-created before the fleet barrier. connections=256 @ fleet_cpu=2 is the ~80% single-pod calibration (AGENTS.md §7).
